pipeline: Three.js 0.184.0 native WebGPU + TSL; explicit capability gate; no silent WebGL fallback

quality.geometry: Full editable source and complete uncompressed export retained; sharing, exact batching and per-pass GPU frustum selection
quality.vegetation: Complete nearby geometry; source-derived 8-azimuth albedo/normal atlases beyond 80-110 m, preloaded with hysteresis
quality.shadow_query: Full source models; static shadow cache valid for fixed geometry and illumination
quality.reflection: Live camera-correct lake planar capture at native sample density; independently owned main/reflection/shadow instance data

water.lake: Fresnel reflection with subtle periodic optical ripple
water.stream: Real supported rippled mesh with view-transformed geometric normals and advected optical detail

sky.solar_disc: Analytic angular solar disk aligned with the shadow-casting source; native HDR supplies cloud radiance
sky.background_source_sun: native HDR lobe; yaw adjusted together with direct light
sky.reference_grade: sunward neutral-cloud amber grade; blue opposing sky retained
sky.provenance: Original ImageGen sky-only equirectangular panorama, no landscape projection; retained at native output resolution

terrain.weights: Color.r trail, Color.g litter, Color.b exposed geology

lighting.bounce_transport: Documented broad warm valley indirect approximation; primary visibility comes from the real shadowed solar source.

frame_pacing: Up to three submissions in flight, with GPU-completed frame counters and separate presentation/submission intervals. Static object transforms evaluated once; dynamic instance data, camera and water remain live.
provenance: Existing local editable original assets and verified CC0 botanical/rock libraries revised independently for the supplied reference. Former project validation was not reused.
